notes: Claude now takes off one pipe run at a time: it places a run with its fittings, reviews it on the drawing, and only then starts the next run. Its questions are pinned on the fittings and pipes it has placed, after it has reviewed them, and it carries on without waiting for the answer. Both can be turned off in Settings > Claude. The Night theme is now dark red, and Settings > Themes has an Accent Colour picker, kept for each theme. The Magnifier button on the bottom bar is now Select Filter: a box drag can pick only counts, pipes or notes, and notes can now be picked, moved and deleted with a box (the magnifier stays on M).
